decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells like Treasure Cruise and Consider to bring back Arclight Phoenix for powerful recurring attacks. Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse provide removal options, while Picklock Prankster adds disruption to the opponent's hand. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand to ensure consistent draws. With a mix of burn spells and evasion creatures, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and maximize the value of Arclight Phoenix's ability.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient and low-cost creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Emberheart Challenger, and Soul-Scar Mage to chip away at their life total. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, the deck can adapt to various board states and apply constant pressure to force the opponent to react defensively. Land options provide flexibility in mana production to support the aggressive game plan.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with efficient creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, the deck aims to deal damage early and often. With a mix of aggressive creatures and direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck can quickly take control of the game and put pressure on the opponent. The lands in the deck provide a good mix of mana sources to ensure that the aggressive game plan can be executed smoothly.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce your opponent's life total. By consistently dealing damage and overwhelming your opponent with creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, you aim to end the game quickly before your opponent can stabilize. With a high density of efficient burn spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning, you can also finish off your opponent or clear the way for your creatures to attack. The deck also includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to provide additional options for closing out the game.

This deck focuses on using cheap spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard, while also utilizing evasion and damage spells to quickly take down opponents. The key is to efficiently cycle through the deck with card draw and cantrips, in order to consistently bring back the Phoenix and pressure the opponent. Additionally, there are some disruptive elements like Picklock Prankster and Fiery Impulse to deal with threats, making sure the path is clear for the Phoenix to soar in for the win.
